Gourmia Shop and Gourmia Cook both still sell this exact model in stock for $59.99, and the Gourmia Factory Store has it at $76.99. That is 41% below the lowest verified non-Amazon market price, or about $25 off. Stock is tight, with only 2 left and a limit of 3 per customer.
